canvas.$description: App background behind everything; the open sky.

default.$description: Default surface for lists, screens and sheets.

raised.$description: Cards, popovers and sheets lifted above default. In dark mode, raised is lighter (tonal elevation).

subtle.$description: Dividers between list rows. Decorative; no contrast requirement.

default.$description: Input outlines, checkbox and radio rings. Must reach 3:1 (UI component).

focus.$description: 2px focus ring on every interactive element.

disabled.$description: Disabled labels. Exempt from WCAG contrast; never the only signal of state.

primary.$description: Primary button fill, selected tab, active nav item.

secondary.$description: Tonal button fill and selected chip background. One step darker than the canvas so its edge is visible.

on-inverse.$description: Action text on surface/inverse: the Undo in a snackbar.

income.$description: Money in. Always paired with a + sign.

expense.$description: Money out. Neutral ink, never red, with a − sign. Spending is normal, not a failure.

over-budget.$description: Amount past a limit. Paired with a ▲ icon and the word 'over'.

near-limit.$description: At 80% of a limit or more. Paired with an icon and 'close to limit'.

neutral-change.$description: No change month on month. Paired with '±0' or 'same as last month'.

headroom.$description: Signature: the open space left under a limit.

spent.$description: Signature: the filled base of a clearance gauge.

over-fill.$description: Gauge fill past the clearance line.

near-fill.$description: Gauge fill at 80% of a limit or more.

pressed.$description: Pressed wash on rows and ghost buttons.

secondary.$description: Tonal button fill and selected chip background. One step darker than the canvas so its edge is visible.

income.$description: Money in. Always paired with a + sign.

expense.$description: Money out. Neutral ink, never red, with a − sign. Spending is normal, not a failure.

spent.$description: Signature: the filled base of a clearance gauge.

over-fill.$description: Gauge fill past the clearance line.

near-fill.$description: Gauge fill at 80% of a limit or more.

pressed.$description: Pressed wash on rows and ghost buttons.

display.$description: Onboarding and empty-state headlines. One per screen at most.

body-lg.$description: Primary reading text on mobile (matches iOS Body).

body-md.$description: Default body, list subtitles, web body.

caption.$description: Chart axes, footnotes. 12 is the floor; nothing smaller ships.

hero.$description: The one number that answers 'am I okay?' (headroom on Home).

lg.$description: Budget and goal totals, balance-card secondary figures.

compact.$description: Chart labels, chips, keypad history: condenses on the width axis instead of shrinking below the 12px floor.

100.$description: Icon to label inside a chip; amount to its sign.

150.$description: Title to subtitle in a list row.

200.$description: Gap between inline controls; chip padding.

300.$description: List row vertical padding; gap between cards in a grid.

400.$description: Screen side margin (mobile); card inner padding.

500.$description: Card inner padding (large); button horizontal padding.

600.$description: Screen side margin (tablet/web); gap between groups.

2000.$description: Web landing and onboarding hero breathing room.

none.$description: Container edge ↔ full-bleed content. Edge-to-edge image at the top of a goal card; a list that runs to the card edge.

xs.$description: Badge edge ↔ its number. Count badge on the bell icon.

sm.$description: Small container ↔ content. Tooltip, category icon inside its tile.

md.$description: Compact container ↔ content. Snackbar, insight card in a dense grid.

lg.$description: Card ↔ content. Balance card, budget card, alerts.

xl.$description: Sheet or modal ↔ content. Bottom sheet, dialog, onboarding panel, web dashboard card.

2xl.$description: Spacious panel ↔ content. Empty states and onboarding panels: top and bottom breathing room.

block.$description: Tag edge ↔ label (top and bottom). Status badge such as 'Paid'.

inline.$description: Tag edge ↔ label (sides). Status badge such as 'Paid'.

block.$description: Chip edge ↔ label (top and bottom). Filter chips, segmented control segments.

inline.$description: Chip edge ↔ label (sides). Filter chips, segmented control segments.

block.$description: Row or input edge ↔ content (top and bottom). List rows, text inputs.

inline.$description: Row or input edge ↔ content (sides). List rows and text inputs.

block.$description: Button edge ↔ label (top and bottom). Primary and secondary buttons.

inline.$description: Button edge ↔ label (sides). Primary and secondary buttons; wider sides make the label easy to scan.
Large button edge ↔ label (sides). 56px full-width and onboarding buttons.

block.$description: Rail item edge ↔ icon and label (top and bottom). Web navigation rail items, keypad keys.

inline.$description: Rail item edge ↔ icon and label (sides). Web navigation rail items, keypad keys.

amount-to-caption.$description: Big amount ↔ the line that explains it. ₹18,450 ↔ 'left to spend this month'.

title-to-subtitle.$description: Title ↔ its supporting line. 'Swiggy' ↔ 'Food and dining · Today' in a row.

label-to-field.$description: Field label ↔ input. 'Amount' ↔ the amount field.

field-to-helper.$description: Input ↔ helper or error text. Field ↔ 'Enter a UPI ID like name@bank'.

heading-to-body.$description: Heading ↔ the paragraph it introduces. Sheet title ↔ its explanation.

list-item.$description: Bullet ↔ next bullet. Steps in a help article.

paragraph.$description: Paragraph ↔ paragraph. About 55% of body line height (22px), inside the 40–75% readability band.

body-to-action.$description: Last line of text ↔ the button or link that acts on it. Empty-state body ↔ 'Add a budget'.

section-heading-below.$description: Section heading ↔ first item under it. 'Upcoming bills' ↔ first bill row.

section-heading-above.$description: Previous content ↔ next section heading. Last budget row ↔ 'Upcoming bills'. Always at least 1.5× the space below a heading.

inline.$description: Value ↔ inline qualifier. '₹740' ↔ 'over' badge; amount ↔ trend arrow.

to-text-sm.$description: 16px icon ↔ small text (13–14px). Warning icon ↔ 'Close to limit'; sync dot ↔ 'Updated 2 min ago'.

to-text-md.$description: 20–24px icon ↔ label (14–17px). Icon ↔ label in buttons, chips, menu items and nav.

to-badge.$description: Icon ↔ notification badge overlap. Badge sits 2px inside the bell's top-right corner.

to-icon.$description: Icon ↔ icon (not tappable). Status icons in a row; card brand marks.

control-to-label.$description: Checkbox, radio, toggle or menu icon ↔ its label. 'Round to the rupee' beside its checkbox; menu item icon to text.

target-to-target.$description: 48px tap target ↔ next 48px tap target. App-bar actions. Targets touch; the 24px glyphs end up 24px apart.

tile-to-text.$description: 40px tile or avatar ↔ row text. Category tile ↔ 'Swiggy' in a transaction row.

thumb-to-text.$description: 56px+ thumbnail ↔ text. Goal photo ↔ goal name and progress.

image-to-caption.$description: Image or chart ↔ its caption. Chart ↔ 'Last 6 months'.

card-image-to-content.$description: Full-bleed card image ↔ card text. Same as the card inset so text lines up with the card padding.

amount-to-visual.$description: Hero amount ↔ gauge or chart. ₹18,450 caption ↔ clearance gauge.

illustration-to-headline.$description: Illustration ↔ headline. Empty states, onboarding, goal reached.

row-to-row.$description: List row ↔ list row. Rows already have squish padding; a hairline divider separates them.

control-inline.$description: Chip ↔ chip (wraps). Filter chips, amount suggestion chips. Same gap across and down.

button-stack.$description: Full-width button ↔ button. Primary over secondary in a sheet footer.

card-to-card.$description: Card ↔ card in a list. Goal cards on mobile. Grids use the layout gutter instead.

field-to-field.$description: Form field ↔ form field. Amount ↔ category ↔ note.

alert-to-content.$description: Inline alert ↔ content below. 'Bank sync paused' banner ↔ balance card.

group-to-group.$description: Group ↔ group within a section. Budget summary ↔ category budgets.

fieldset-to-fieldset.$description: Form section ↔ form section. 'Limit' settings ↔ 'Alerts' settings.

compact.$description: Grid column ↔ column; card ↔ card in a grid (compact).

medium.$description: Grid column ↔ column; card ↔ card in a grid (medium).

expanded.$description: Grid column ↔ column; card ↔ card in a grid (expanded).

large.$description: Grid column ↔ column; card ↔ card in a grid (large).

compact.$description: Last content ↔ bottom nav or page end (compact).

medium.$description: Last content ↔ bottom nav or page end (medium).

expanded.$description: Last content ↔ bottom nav or page end (expanded).

large.$description: Last content ↔ bottom nav or page end (large).

xl.$description: Bottom sheet and modal top corners.

brand.$description: Display, titles and every amount. The brand lives in the numbers.

ui.$description: Body, labels and controls. Native on phones (Dynamic Type, native feel); brand face on web.

2.$description: Sticky bars on scroll, dropdowns, FAB, tooltips.

hairline.$description: Dividers, card outlines in dark mode, input rest state.

strong.$description: Focus ring, selected chip or radio, error input.

clearance.$description: Dash pattern of the clearance line (6px dash, 4px gap).

xs.$description: Inline with body-sm and caption; badge glyphs.

md.$description: Default: nav bar, app bar actions, list leading icons.

lg.$description: Empty states and onboarding (inside a 64 tile).

fast.$description: Press feedback, toggles, checkbox ticks, color changes.

base.$description: Hover, tab indicator, chip selection, small reveals.

moderate.$description: Bottom sheet and modal enter, page push.

slow.$description: Gauge and progress fills, chart draw on first view.

deliberate.$description: Goal reached. The only celebration, once per goal.

exit.$description: Things leaving: dismissals. Exits run at about 70% of enter duration.

linear.$description: Indeterminate loaders and skeleton shimmer only.

min.$description: Minimum hit area for anything tappable, all platforms.

sm.$description: Dense web controls; hit area still padded to 48 on touch.

md.$description: Lists; matches the category icon tile.

nav-bar.$description: Bottom nav height before the safe-area inset.

large.$description: Large-title app bar before it collapses.

compact.$description: Phones. Bottom nav bar, single column.

medium.$description: Large phones landscape, small tablets. Bottom nav, two-column cards.

expanded.$description: Tablets, small laptops. Navigation rail, list and detail side by side.

large.$description: Web dashboard. Side navigation, content max width 1200.
